raw_response: {"diagnosis":"The stale-event filter added under DE-412 (ingest_ts - txn_ts <= 26 hours) silently drops valid POSTED transactions that arrive about 3 days after txn_ts. This is a recurring pattern in every batch, about 25% of rows, well above the roughly 5% that are REVERSED. Removing the filter restores the lost rows, keeping only the status = 'POSTED' condition.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.6,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
